links.comparator_used: Fully automated AI lesion segmentation without physician review (method 1) versus fully automated with physician review (method 3); semi-automated method 5 as reference
links.outcome: Processing time to obtain TMTV and TLG (the abstract reports agreement for the reviewed method 3 against reference, not for unreviewed method 1)
links.effect: Mean processing time 20 s ± 9.0 for fully automated method 1 vs 178 s ± 125.7 for automated with physician review (method 3) vs 326 s ± 188.6 for semi-automated method 5 (p < 0.05). Method 3 vs method 5 ICC 0.99 for TMTV and 1.0 for TLG.
links.tradeoff: Physician review of the automated segmentation added roughly 158 s per case compared with fully automated processing, though it was still faster than the semi-automated reference method.
links.quote: Mean processing time (± standard deviation) was 20 s ± 9.0 for method 1, 178 s ± 125.7 for method 3, and 326 s ± 188.6 for method 5 (p < 0.05).
